lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.focus: constant rate of change versus constant ratio
lessonRef.title: Investigation or close reading: constant rate of change versus constant ratio

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: This example shows the kind of reasoning the investigation asks for.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Talk through what changes and what stays fixed before you answer.

items.prompt: An asset's value is modelled by V(t) = 2700(0.97)^t, with t in years. What does 2700 represent?
choices: the fraction of value retained each year, 0.97, meaning a 3% annual loss
the number of years until the asset is worthless
the total value lost over the asset's life
the value of the asset when it was new, $2700

items.prompt: A linear model passes through (3, -6) and (8, -1). Write it in the form f(x) = mx + b.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A table of successive outputs reads 2, 4, 6, 8. Is the relationship linear or exponential, and why?
choices: Neither; the pattern does not repeat.
Exponential; successive outputs have a constant ratio of 2.
Quadratic; the second differences are constant.
Linear; successive outputs differ by a constant 2.

items.prompt: A population of 2700 grows by 16% per year. Write the model P(t) and find the population after 4 years, to the nearest whole number.
Quantity A grows by 106 units each year. Quantity B doubles or triples each year, with ratio 2, starting from a much smaller value. Which statement is true in the long run?
choices: The two grow at the same eventual rate.
A stays ahead permanently because 106 is larger than 2.
B eventually exceeds A and stays ahead, however large A’s constant increase is.
B exceeds A only if B starts larger than A.

items.prompt: An asset's value is modelled by V(t) = 2500(0.9)^t, with t in years. What does 2500 represent?
choices: the total value lost over the asset's life
the value of the asset when it was new, $2500
the fraction of value retained each year, 0.9, meaning a 10% annual loss
the number of years until the asset is worthless

sections.title: Extension and challenge
sections.directions: Write out the reasoning in full sentences. A correct answer with no justification does not count here.

items.prompt: A linear model passes through (1, 8) and (3, 0). Write it in the form f(x) = mx + b.
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.

items.prompt: A table of successive outputs reads 6, 12, 18, 24. Is the relationship linear or exponential, and why?
items.responseExpectation: Give the result and the reasoning that produced it. Show enough work that someone else could check each step.
